snippet_primary: "In 2025, 93.539 million consumers purchased items from Etsy. An estimated 5.90 million Etsy consumers (7%) are habitual buyers. There was a 2.01% YoY decrease in repeat buyers in 2025. The average Etsy consumer spends $127.40 on the marketplace in a year. Approximately 40% of GMS in 2025 came from habitual buyers, down 2.44% YoY. Mobile users (through the Etsy app) purchased 45% of consolidated GMS in 2025, up 7.14% YoY."
